title: Diagonal Hom classes detect eventual equality at a later stage
statement:
Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preordered set, let $\mathcal C_i$ and $\mathcal D$ be categories, and let $(T_{ij},\Phi_i,\theta_{ij},\tau_{ijk})$ be a coherent normalized cocone with category $\mathcal C_\infty$, transition maps $t$ and comparison functor $\Phi$ as defined in [det-def-sfb-filtered-two-colimit-model]. All indexing sets and Hom sets are sets in fixed sufficiently large universes. Fix $k\in I$, $x,y\in\mathcal C_k$, and $g,g':x\to y$. Put
$$\delta_k(g):=[k,T_{kk}(g)]:(k,x)\to(k,y).$$
Then
$$\Phi(\delta_k(g))=\Phi_k(g),\qquad t_{kn}(T_{kk}(g))=T_{kn}(g)\quad(n\ge k),$$
where the transition $t_{kn}$ is formed for the fixed pair $(k,x),(k,y)$; the endpoints in these identities are identified by the normalization of the cocone. Moreover,
$$\delta_k(g)=\delta_k(g')\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad\exists n\ge k,\ T_{kn}(g)=T_{kn}(g').$$
